question_text: A delivery robot normally uses a distance sensor, controller and braking actuator to stop before an obstacle. Its sensor now sends an explicit failure flag. The safe response is to brake and request assistance. Outline how the controller and actuator should respond to this input.
adaptation_rationale: Retain sensor failure reasoning in an explicitly described autonomous control loop. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: The controller recognizes the failure flag instead of treating it as a clear path, and sends a stop/brake command to the actuator while requesting assistance.

marking_points.criterion: Controller detects failure input and chooses the safe stop response.
Braking actuator applies the stop command rather than continuing motion.
